adv_addresses.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics WHERE birth_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '70 years'

adv_dob_list.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics WHERE birth_date IS NOT NULL

adv_min_name.sql: SELECT MIN(p.family_name) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p JOIN sqlonfhir.condition_simple c ON c.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE (c.code_text ILIKE '%hypertension%' OR c.icd10_display ILIKE '%hypertension%' OR c.snomed_display ILIKE '%hypertension%')

adv_names.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p JOIN sqlonfhir.condition_simple c ON c.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE (c.code_text ILIKE '%diabetes%' OR c.icd10_display ILIKE '%diabetes%' OR c.snomed_display ILIKE '%diabetes%')

age_over_18.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p WHERE p.birth_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '18 years'

age_under_65.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics WHERE birth_date::date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '65 years'

cond_diabetes.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.condition_simple c WHERE (c.code_text ILIKE '%diabetes%' OR c.icd10_display ILIKE '%diabetes%' OR c.snomed_display ILIKE '%diabetes%')

cond_hypertension.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.condition_simple c WHERE (c.code_text ILIKE '%hypertension%' OR c.icd10_display ILIKE '%hypertension%' OR c.snomed_display ILIKE '%hypertension%')

count_distinct_condition_texts.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT code_text) FROM sqlonfhir.condition_simple WHERE code_text IS NOT NULL

count_distinct_labs.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT code_display) FROM sqlonfhir.observation_labs WHERE code_display IS NOT NULL

diabetes_and_hypertension.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p JOIN sqlonfhir.condition_simple c1 ON c1.patient_id = p.patient_id JOIN sqlonfhir.condition_simple c2 ON c2.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE (c1.code_text ILIKE '%diabetes%' OR c1.icd10_display ILIKE '%diabetes%' OR c1.snomed_display ILIKE '%diabetes%') AND (c2.code_text ILIKE '%hypertension%' OR c2.icd10_display ILIKE '%hypertension%' OR c2.snomed_display ILIKE '%hypertension%')

female_hypertension_under_65.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p JOIN sqlonfhir.condition_simple c ON c.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE p.gender = 'female' AND p.birth_date::date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '65 years' AND (c.code_text ILIKE '%hypertension%' OR c.icd10_display ILIKE '%hypertension%' OR c.snomed_display ILIKE '%hypertension%')

female_under_65.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p WHERE p.gender = 'female' AND p.birth_date::date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '65 years'

female_with_medication.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.medication_requests m JOIN sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p ON p.patient_id = m.patient_id WHERE p.gender = 'female'

gender_female.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p WHERE p.gender = 'female'

gender_male.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p WHERE p.gender = 'male'

lab_glucose.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.observation_labs o WHERE o.code_display ILIKE '%glucose%'

lab_glucose_high.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.observation_labs o WHERE o.code_display ILIKE '%glucose%' AND o.value_quantity::numeric > 125 AND o.value_unit ILIKE '%mg/dL%'

male_over_18_diabetes.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p JOIN sqlonfhir.condition_simple c ON c.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE p.gender = 'male' AND p.birth_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '18 years' AND (c.code_text ILIKE '%diabetes%' OR c.icd10_display ILIKE '%diabetes%' OR c.snomed_display ILIKE '%diabetes%')

negation_no_meds.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p WHERE p.patient_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT m.patient_id FROM sqlonfhir.medication_requests m WHERE m.patient_id IS NOT NULL)

negation_without_diabetes.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.patient_demographics p WHERE p.patient_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT c.patient_id FROM sqlonfhir.condition_simple c WHERE c.code_text ILIKE '%diabetes%' OR c.icd10_display ILIKE '%diabetes%' OR c.snomed_display ILIKE '%diabetes%')

temporal_med_since_2021.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.medication_requests m WHERE m.authored_on::date >= '2021-01-01'

temporal_procedure_after_2020.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM sqlonfhir.procedure_history p WHERE p.performed_datetime::date > '2020-01-01' OR p.performed_period_start::date > '2020-01-01'
